_about: Broadcast records over #90's channel grid (architecture, kinds, and generator vocabulary are #90's; zero channels are canon there and zero are asserted here). Airing is derived at read time via #124's rotation discipline — nothing stores 'on air now'. stateInputs are inherited from the #90 block: a record may narrow, never widen; a broadcast with no state input is authored script and must be labelled as such.

broadcast.contentClass: weather | phenomena | league | forest_bulletin | community | deeds
broadcast.schedule: cadence over #19 phases, resolved via #124 rotation derivation
stateInputs: system refs the block reads — inherited from #90, narrow-only

content_class_rules.community: #90 schedule_notice generator — who is where, gatherings, #164 board postings
content_class_rules.deeds: #90 event_echo — the Ranger's deeds reported back from #12 facts
content_class_rules.forest_bulletin: TRACE-class only (sign | effect | absence, #163) — never a location, never a withheld species; the depths contribute absence (#84) and can only ever be an authored beat, never a generator output
content_class_rules.league: reads #143 instances + #151/#100 result facts — coverage of records; may not invent a fixture
content_class_rules.phenomena: reads #153 records — condition windows + witness reports
content_class_rules.weather: reads #61 producer output filtered by #142 climate — REPORTS of effective state

forecast_rule: #142's law binds verbatim: media may only report the effective state — no forecasting fiction the system can't back. A forecast is legal ONLY as a labelled projection of a deterministic derivation (#124 rotation fixtures, #153 condition windows). The record has no field for an unbacked forecast. Registered as a clarification in STAGING (the commissioning brief's 'weather forecasts' survive only in this derived sense).
open_register: every channel / programme / media personality (inherited #90 — none canon)
every block schedule (waits on #124's OPEN calendar)
league content beyond Region 1's circuit (R2-5 league records are null, #143)
voice_law: a cry may appear as recorded sound exactly as it sounds in the field (#84 placed cries) — a cry is NEVER broadcast as speech: no translated cries, no creature interviews, no verbalisation (#81's discipline binds media)
